card.fires_on: The words just before "14 days" in phrases like "at least" or "a minimum of", in MAOI switching instructions. It follows mentions of monoamine oxidase inhibitors.

modes.label: At least before 14 days
modes.description: The word "least" or the space after it in "At least 14 days should elapse" in MAOI switching sections.
